Risk title: Excess AWS privileges after role changes
Risk event: Privilege misuse or compromised stale admin role exposes ePHI
Action: Validate removal of the three identified unnecessary entitlements; conduct broader privileged-access reconciliation; perform monthly AWS privileged reviews and quarterly formal certification; implement time-bound admin elevation

Risk event: Subprocessor or weak vendor security leads to ePHI disclosure
Action: Obtain executed BAA; review SOC 2 bridge letter and subprocessor list; conditional procurement hold

Risk title: S3 public exposure via configuration drift
Risk event: Misconfigured bucket or access point makes sensitive objects accessible
Existing controls (assumed): Block Public Access; AWS Config alerts
Action: Enforce organization-level public access block and test alerts monthly

Risk event: Malware or compromised automation interrupts patient scheduling
Action: Run restoration exercise and isolate build agents

Risk event: Security event is not escalated within required internal response targets
Action: Exercise incident escalation and document BAA notification timelines

Risk event: Leaked long-lived token enables unauthorized deployment
Action: Migrate deploy workflows to OIDC and rotate remaining tokens

Risk event: Unrestorable backup causes prolonged data recovery
Action: Quarterly restore tests with RTO/RPO evidence

Risk event: Stolen device reveals locally cached patient information
Action: Validate encryption compliance and remote wipe exercise

Risk event: Exploitable flaw permits unauthorized access or service disruption
Action: Enforce critical patch exception approval and weekly SLA report

Risk event: Logs unavailable for investigation and customer assurance
Action: Document retention requirements and test 12-month retrieval

Risk event: Former employee retains active application access
Action: Reconcile HR departures to application access monthly

Risk event: ePHI disclosure to party without required executed agreement
Action: Reconcile all ePHI flows with executed BAA inventory
